preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 15 for N in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and not line.split()[0].isdigit() or (line.strip() and len(line.split())==2)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is between 1 and 15 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= M < N*(N-1)//2 for N, M in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdin_text.splitlines()[1:] if line.strip() and len(line.split())==2 and all(c.isdigit() for c in line.split())])
preconditions.description: For each test case, M is between 0 and N*(N-1)/2 exclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for N, M, edges in [(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1]), [(int(e.split()[0]), int(e.split()[1])) for e in next_lines]) for line, next_lines in zip(stdin_text.splitlines()[1::], [stdin_text.splitlines()[i+2:i+2+int(line.split()[1])] for i in range(1, len(stdin_text.splitlines()), 1) if line.strip() and len(line.split())==2]) for u, v in edges]
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints X and Y are between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(parts) == 2 and parts[0].isdigit() and parts[1].isdigit() for parts in [line.split() for line in stdout_text.strip().splitlines()])
postconditions.description: Each output line contains two space-separated non-negative integers x and y.

postconditions.expression: all(A * x == B * y and x > 0 and y > 0 and gcd(x, y) == 1 for (A, B, x, y) in zip([min(S) for S in [compute_S(N, edges) for N, edges in parse_test_cases(stdin_text)]], [max(S) for S in [compute_S(N, edges) for N, edges in parse_test_cases(stdin_text)]], [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdout_text.strip().splitlines()], [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdout_text.strip().splitlines()]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, x and y are the minimum positive integers satisfying Ax = By, where A is the minimum S value and B is the maximum S value across all vertices, and gcd(x, y) = 1.
